## NFL Transactions Briefing — 11/17

- **Packers signed WR Coleman Owen to the practice squad.**  
  *Impact:* Depth add at receiver; likely a developmental move unless injuries force a call-up.

- **Eagles signed Leki Fotu to the practice squad veteran spot.**  
  *Impact:* Adds experienced interior depth; useful insurance on the defensive front.

- **Chiefs signed TE John FitzPatrick to the practice squad veteran spot.**  
  *Impact:* Gives Kansas City extra tight end depth and a veteran option for elevation.

- **Titans signed S Michael Carter to the practice squad veteran spot.**  
  *Impact:* Secondary depth move; could matter quickly if Tennessee needs safety help.

- **Texans signed DL Sabastian Harsh to the practice squad.**  
  *Impact:* Developmental defensive line depth.

- **Cowboys signed OL Nick Leverett as a free agent.**  
  *Impact:* More offensive line depth with a path to immediate backup duty if Dallas needs interior help.

- **Vikings signed DB D'Anthony Bell to the practice squad veteran spot.**  
  *Impact:* Adds experienced depth in the secondary and on special teams.

- **Dolphins signed QB Brady Cook as a free agent.**  
  *Impact:* Quarterback room depth; likely a developmental or emergency-depth addition.

- **Dolphins signed ED Eric Watts as a free agent.**  
  *Impact:* Edge depth for a roster that may be looking for rotational pass-rush help.

- **Dolphins signed Matthew Butler to the practice squad veteran spot.**  
  *Impact:* Veteran trench depth, likely tied to broader defensive line turnover.

- **Dolphins signed DL Jordan Jefferson as a free agent.**  
  *Impact:* Another defensive front addition, suggesting Miami is actively reshaping depth up front.

- **Cardinals signed S Wydett Williams Jr. as a free agent.**  
  *Impact:* Safety depth addition, especially notable with an injury move elsewhere in Arizona’s secondary.

- **Cardinals signed DL Jared Harrison-Hunte as a free agent.**  
  *Impact:* Defensive line depth with a chance to compete for rotational snaps.

- **Bills signed DB Te'Cory Couch to the practice squad.**  
  *Impact:* Secondary depth and practice-squad flexibility.

- **Panthers signed TE Joshua Simon to the practice squad.**  
  *Impact:* Tight end depth; likely a developmental addition and emergency option.

- **Steelers signed DB AJ Finley to the practice squad veteran spot.**  
  *Impact:* Veteran defensive back depth, with possible special teams value.

- **Jets signed OL Kohl Levao to the practice squad.**  
  *Impact:* Offensive line depth, always relevant given attrition at the position.

- **Colts signed WR Quez Watkins as a free agent.**  
  *Impact:* Adds speed and experience to the receiver group; worth watching if Indianapolis wants more vertical depth.

- **Eagles signed RB Jaydon Blue as a free agent.**  
  *Impact:* Running back depth move; likely developmental unless injuries open a roster spot.

- **Titans signed WR Xavier Restrepo as a free agent.**  
  *Impact:* Receiver depth addition; a name to watch if Tennessee is searching for passing-game help.

- **Dolphins placed DT Jordan Phillips on Reserve/Injured.**  
  *Impact:* Costs Miami interior defensive line depth and helps explain the cluster of defensive-front additions.

- **Cardinals placed S Andrew Wingard on Reserve/Injured.**  
  *Impact:* Arizona loses safety depth; the Williams signing looks like a direct response.

- **Bills placed OL Ar'maj Reed-Adams on Reserve/Injured.**  
  *Impact:* Thins Buffalo’s line depth and raises the importance of replacement options behind the starters.

- **Colts placed LB Jaylon Carlies on Reserve/Injured.**  
  *Impact:* Linebacker depth takes a hit; could affect sub-package and special teams roles.

- **Panthers waived LB Nick Hampton (terminated via waivers).**  
  *Impact:* Carolina opens a roster spot and moves on from a linebacker depth piece.

- **Lions waived DB Nick Whiteside (terminated via waivers).**  
  *Impact:* Minor secondary-depth turnover.

- **Rams waived WR Brennan Presley (terminated via waivers).**  
  *Impact:* Los Angeles clears a receiver roster spot; limited immediate fantasy impact unless followed by another move.

- **Dolphins waived K Zane Gonzalez (terminated via waivers).**  
  *Impact:* Miami’s kicking situation changes; this is a specialist move worth monitoring for follow-up.

- **Giants waived WR Charlie Jones (terminated via waivers).**  
  *Impact:* Receiver depth shakeup; likely more relevant for roster churn than the offensive pecking order.

- **Seahawks waived DL Deven Eastern (terminated via waivers).**  
  *Impact:* Seattle opens a spot on the defensive front.

- **Cowboys waived OL Ajani Cornelius.**  
  *Impact:* Another Dallas offensive line move on the same day as the Leverett signing; suggests active depth reshuffling.

- **Cardinals waived OL Albert Reese.**  
  *Impact:* Opens a roster spot as Arizona adjusts depth across multiple position groups.

- **Browns waived Elijah Chatman.**  
  *Impact:* Cleveland clears space on the defensive front; exact roster context beyond that is not specified.

- **Browns were assigned DL Jamree Kromah via waivers from the Dolphins.**  
  *Impact:* Cleveland adds a defensive lineman through the claims process; Miami loses a front-seven depth piece.

- **Browns waived TE Carsen Ryan.**  
  *Impact:* Tight end depth decreases as Cleveland makes room elsewhere on the roster.

## What stands out
- **Miami was the busiest team.** The Dolphins added **Brady Cook, Eric Watts, Matthew Butler, and Jordan Jefferson**, while also placing **Jordan Phillips** on injured reserve, waiving **Zane Gonzalez**, and losing **Jamree Kromah** on waivers to Cleveland.  
  *Why it matters:* Miami clearly reworked both the defensive front and specialist/depth areas in one sweep.

- **Arizona made linked moves.** The Cardinals put **Andrew Wingard** on injured reserve, then added **Wydett Williams Jr.** and **Jared Harrison-Hunte**, while waiving **Albert Reese**.  
  *Why it matters:* Safety depth was directly affected, and the roster churn touched both the secondary and trenches.

- **Dallas reshuffled the offensive line.** Signing **Nick Leverett** and waiving **Ajani Cornelius** points to a direct depth swap.  
  *Why it matters:* Could reflect short-term readiness preference up front.

## What to watch next
- Whether any of the **Miami defensive line additions** move quickly onto the active roster.
- Whether **Quez Watkins** can carve out a real role for the Colts’ passing game.
- Any follow-up move from the **Dolphins at kicker** after waiving **Zane Gonzalez**.
- Whether the **Cardinals’ safety depth** gets tested further after **Andrew Wingard** went to IR.

## Injury briefing

### Jaguars: C Robert Hainsey — week-to-week
- **What happened:** Hainsey left last Sunday’s win over the Titans with a **knee injury**. ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler reports it’s a **sprain** and he’s considered **week-to-week**.
- **Why it matters:** Hainsey has **started every game this season**, so this is a notable hit to Jacksonville’s offensive-line continuity. The Jaguars will need to adjust at center while he’s out.
- **What to watch next:** His return timeline is **not specified**, but he’s **not expected to miss the rest of the regular season**.

### Dolphins: DT Jordan Phillips — out for season
- **What happened:** Phillips will **miss the rest of the season** with a **torn biceps**, per a source confirmed to ESPN.
- **Why it matters:** This is another blow to Miami’s defensive tackle group and adds to the team’s season-long depth issues up front.
- **What to watch next:** The Dolphins will need to shuffle interior defensive-line reps; no return timeline is expected this season.

- **No players returning from injury were specified in today’s data.**
